title: The Antikythera Mechanism: Full Story of the 2,000-Year-Old Computer
description:
In 1901, divers lifted a corroded bronze lump from an ancient shipwreck off the Greek island of Antikythera. Inside were gears that modelled the Sun, Moon, planets and eclipses. Here's the full story, and how X-rays and 3D scans revealed how it worked.
